summary: Tested PAYO backend (12/12 pytest passing) and frontend Expo web preview. Backend APIs (dashboard/today, exchange-rate, transactions, recent-recipients, transfer, qris/generate, qris/static) all working correctly with proper validation, persistence, and serialization (no _id leak). Frontend dashboard renders with PAYO logo, Welcome card, Milea Concert event, today's income (Rp79.436.419 / 4,567.76 USDT), USDT/IDR toggle works, all 5 recent transactions visible. Navigation working: Lihat Detail (with prev/next pagination over 5 pages), Lihat Semua, Input Manual (QR generates), Tampilkan QRIS (static QR with merchant Milea Concert + ID PAYO00012345), Transfer (recipient list + form), Scan QRIS (camera permission UI). Bottom tabs Dashboard/Pendapatan/Settings render in tab bar. Dashboard scrolls correctly.

minor.issue: Hardcoded fallback total_usdt=9020.21 when no IN-direction tx today — could mask real zero-income state in prod

ui_bugs.issue: Submit success uses Alert.alert with router.back() in OK callback. On RN web Playwright dismisses dialog before callback; UX-wise still works on native. Consider toast/snackbar for cross-platform consistency.

issues: Web fallback message ('Pemindai QRIS hanya tersedia pada perangkat...') is gated behind permission.granted, but on web the permission is initially not granted, so user sees 'Izinkan Akses Kamera' instead. Move Platform.OS==='web' branch BEFORE the permission.granted check so web preview shows the proper fallback immediately.

action_items: (LOW) scan-qris.tsx: move `if (Platform.OS === 'web')` block above the permission check so web preview shows the proper fallback message instead of camera-permission prompt.
(LOW) transfer.tsx: replace Alert.alert success with cross-platform toast or direct router.back so web flow returns to dashboard without dialog.
(OPTIONAL) backend dashboard/today: remove or guard the hardcoded 9020.21 fallback when no income exists today (could be confusing in production).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] / DB_NAME correctly; CORS open; CoinGecko has 5-min cache + safe fallback (16250). Good.
All endpoints return _id-stripped docs via serialize_tx — good.
Dashboard, transfer, transaction-detail components have testID coverage on all interactive elements — excellent.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 transactions on first /dashboard/today or /transactions call. Tests created 2 TEST_ transfers via POST /api/transfer (left in DB; minor noise but harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL: https://qvac-payment-suite.preview.emergentagent.com — Expo tunnel takes ~60s to come up after restart; first request may 502 until 'Tunnel ready' appears in /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log. Run pytest with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_payo_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. For UI Alert.alert on web, register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` to auto-handle them.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Two minor UX issues identified (scan-qris web fallback ordering, transfer success Alert) and one cosmetic (hardcoded today fallback on backend). All listed flows from the review request are functionally working.
